description: This file is a C++ source file implementing a server manager simulation for testing purposes. It includes functions to retrieve environment variables, configure server startup parameters, and runs a test HTTP server with detailed instructions printed to stderr.

methods.name: getSessionServerPath
methods.description: Retrieves the session server path from environment variable or defaults to '/usr/bin/RialtoServer'.

methods.name: getStartupTimeout
methods.description: Retrieves the startup timeout from environment variable or defaults to zero milliseconds.

methods.name: getEnvironmentVariables
methods.description: Parses environment variables from a semicolon-separated string in environment variable 'SESSION_SERVER_ENV_VARS'.

methods.name: getNumberOfPreloadedServers
methods.description: Retrieves the number of preloaded servers from environment variable 'RIALTO_PRELOADED_SERVERS', defaults to zero.
